description: TypeScript trigger bridge. Capture only brightness/colour/effect channels explicitly changed by a user. Explicit user ON opens the affected room power gate without operating other lamps. Existing logical lamp membership is preserved. Automation and running-script contexts are ignored. Power-only calls create no override.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.event.context.user_id is not none and trigger.event.data.service == 'turn_on' and trigger.event.context.id not in (states.script | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | map(attribute='context') | map(attribute='id') | list) }}
